capabilities: Restyle callouts as LaTeX-style definition or theorem blocks
Titlize callout type IDs into headings with parentheses content italicized
Toggle between bordered and borderless modes
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX renderer or editor; it only changes the appearance of callouts.
problem: Obsidian callouts appear as standard boxed notes with icons, so they cannot look like the definition or theorem blocks used in LaTeX documents.
summary: Callout styling plugin that renders callouts as LaTeX-style definition or theorem blocks with titlized type IDs and indented contents.
